fidelity: F2a — Physics-Lumped Heliostat Optics + Receiver Thermal ODE
source: Stine & Geyer (2001) Power From The Sun (ch. on central receivers); Wagner & Wendelin (2018) SolarPILOT, Solar Energy 171:185-196; Falcone (1986) SAND86-8009; Kolb (2011) SAND2011-2419 (Gemasolar); Zavoico (2001) SAND2001-2120 (Solar Two receiver); Wagner (2008) MS thesis 'Simulation and Predictive Performance Modeling of Utility-Scale Central Receiver System Power Plants'.

unit.name: Generic 100 MW_th Molten-Salt Solar Tower (Gemasolar-like external cylindrical receiver)

A_field.note: Total field reflective area = n_heliostats * A_heliostat

eta_field_peak.note: Peak annual heliostat-field optical efficiency at solar noon (cosine*shading*blocking*reflectivity*atten*spillage product, at design)

reflectivity.note: Clean mirror reflectivity x soiling/availability factor

atm_atten_coeff.note: Atmospheric attenuation loss slope vs solar zenith angle (slant-path proxy)

cosine_loss_coeff.note: Field-averaged cosine loss, parabolic in zenith angle

spillage_frac.note: Beam spillage past the receiver aperture at design point

A_receiver.note: External cylindrical receiver lateral surface area

absorptivity.note: Pyromark 2500 solar absorptivity of receiver tubes

emissivity.note: Pyromark thermal IR emissivity (drives T^4 re-radiation loss)

view_factor.note: Receiver-to-sky radiative view factor (external receiver ~ open to hemisphere)

m_receiver_metal.note: Lumped thermal mass of receiver tube/panel steel (Incoloy/SS) wetted by salt
m_receiver_metal.source: Order-of-magnitude from Zavoico (2001) Solar Two receiver

cp_receiver_metal.note: Specific heat of stainless/Incoloy receiver tubing

m_salt_holdup.note: Molten-salt inventory resident in receiver tubes (lumped with metal mass)

cp_salt.note: Solar salt (60% NaNO3 / 40% KNO3) mean specific heat

T_HTF_in_C.note: Cold molten-salt inlet temperature from cold tank

T_HTF_out_design_C.note: Hot-tank target outlet temperature at design

mdot_salt_design.note: Design HTF mass flow giving ~275 K rise at 100 MWth

eta_powerblock.note: Rankine power-block gross thermal-to-electric efficiency at design
